name: Tenant and employee rights guides, tools and lawyer network for Berlin immigrants

mentions.name: Tenant and employee rights guides, tools and lawyer network for Berlin immigrants
mentions.description: A set of guides, tools, and services helping Berlin immigrants exercise tenant and employee rights. It includes expert-reviewed guides, a tool to check whether your rent is too high, template generators for demanding a rent reduction, and a network of vetted lawyers to see cases through, with the same guides-tools-network model planned for labour rights. The goal is to reduce friction at every step of claiming these rights.
mentions.problem: Exercising tenant and employee rights is full of friction; something as simple as finding a lawyer can derail the whole effort, especially if you don't speak German.
mentions.audience: Berlin immigrants, including those who don't speak German
mentions.source_excerpt: In 2026 I will focus on tenant and employee rights for Berlin's immigrants. I will create guides with help from experts, tools to check if your rent is too high, template generators to demand a rent reduction, and a network of vetted lawyers to help see it through. The goal is to reduce friction at every step of the way.
